notes.title: UPDATE 2.0
notes.notes:
We added additional gaming possibilities. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/8FA4PjKz7PmWEnBpW1/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32715750/b23fb78a1b6b089bdb6ebf8a609b7556485b10a2.png[/img]

We expanded the story content with the overlapping of events in the background. 
We are working on a world within a world add-on so that the experience has even more solutions and twists. 
In the next update, we will present you a sample of this overlapping of worlds as well as some action with the inhabitants.

For more info check our fb https://facebook.com/mymadroad

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hello madness players! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32715750/d4e95ab16158f5b8f340bdf13fad53d0ee634032.jpg[/img]

We would like to inform you that the release date has been postponed. We encountered some unexpected obstacles and our team is only two people, hence the decision. We would like the game to meet all the guidelines we have set and to be a satisfying experience that would deliver quality entertainment. :) We kindly ask you for your patience and understanding and we invite you to visit our Facebook  - https://facebook.com/mymadroad, where more information will be made available in the coming days. 

Thanks! Regards.
